description: Pilot question bank for visual-memory pilot. 2 target-present (chart data recall), 1 target-present (screenshot recall), 1 wrong-source (cross-chart confusion), 1 unanswerable.

questions.prompt: How much did Spotify pay in royalty fees back in 2015? I shared that chart earlier.
What was Porsche's revenue in 2011 according to that automotive chart I showed you?
What was shown in that screenshot I shared? What page or app was it?
What was the revenue figure from that Spotify chart I showed you?
questions.gold_answer: The Spotify chart showed royalty fees (1633.29), not revenue. Answering with Porsche's revenue (10.93) or any other revenue figure would be a wrong-source error.
questions.note: The Spotify chart is about royalty fees, not revenue. The model might confuse it with the Porsche revenue chart and report 10.93 as Spotify's revenue. Correct answer: the Spotify chart showed royalty fees of 1633.29, not revenue.

questions.prompt: What were Spotify's royalty fees in 2016?
questions.note: The chart only shows 2015 data. Any specific 2016 figure is hallucination.
